h1: Custom 1 oz Bags for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom 1 oz bags for gifts and kits. Perfect for branding small items. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom 1 oz bags are ideal for packaging small promotional items like gift sets, sample kits, or travel essentials. These compact bags hold lightweight items such as the Onboard Kit or Perfect 3 Gift Set, making them a practical choice for trade shows and employee appreciation. With options for screen printing or foil stamping, you can add your logo to create a memorable brand impression. Choose durable materials like cotton or non-woven poly for a professional look that fits your budget.
heroAltText: Custom 1 oz bags with printed logos for promotional gift sets and kits
